lived.title: Turkey 🇹🇷 – A Cultural Mosaic
lived.content: Explored Istanbul's bazaars, Cappadocia's fairy chimneys, and Ephesus' ruins. A blend of history and modernity!

lived.title: Germany 🇩🇪 – Efficiency and Engineering
lived.content: Visited Berlin's museums, Munich's beer gardens, and the Black Forest. Prost to the land of poets and thinkers!

lived.title: Poland 🇵🇱 – History and Heritage
lived.content: Explored Krakow's history and Warsaw's resilience. A journey through time!

visited.title: France 🇫🇷 – Wine, Cheese, and Lavender
visited.content: I spent a week in Provence enjoying the vineyards and coastlines. Highlight: Avignon's papal palace!

visited.title: Italy 🇮🇹 – Pasta, Pizza, and Passion
visited.content: From Rome's ruins to Venice's canals, I indulged in gelato and learned to make pasta. Ciao, bella!

visited.title: Spain 🇪🇸 – Flamenco and Fiesta
visited.content: Danced in Seville, savored tapas in Barcelona, and relaxed on Costa del Sol. Olé to the vibrant culture!

visited.title: Greece 🇬🇷 – Myth and Mediterranean
visited.content: Explored Athens' ancient ruins, Santorini's sunsets, and Crete's beaches. Opa to the land of gods!

visited.title: Switzerland 🇨🇭 – Alps and Chocolate
visited.content: Hiked in the Swiss Alps, savored fondue, and enjoyed Zurich's lakeside. A slice of paradise!

visited.title: Netherlands 🇳🇱 – Canals and Culture
visited.content: Rode bikes in Amsterdam, visited tulip fields, and explored windmills. A colorful journey!

visited.title: Portugal 🇵🇹 – Surf and Sun
visited.content: Surfing in Lisbon, exploring Porto's wine cellars, and relaxing on Algarve's beaches. A sun-soaked adventure!

visited.title: Belgium 🇧🇪 – Chocolate and Comics
visited.content: Indulged in Belgian chocolate, explored Brussels' architecture, and enjoyed Bruges' canals. A sweet escape!

visited.title: Austria 🇦🇹 – Music and Mountains
visited.content: Visited Vienna's opera houses, Salzburg's birthplace of Mozart, and Innsbruck's alpine beauty. A harmonious experience!

visited.title: Czech Republic 🇨🇿 – Castles and Culture
visited.content: Explored Prague's historic sites, tasted local beers, and enjoyed the Bohemian countryside. A fairy tale come true!

visited.title: Finland 🇫🇮 – Nature and Northern Lights
visited.content: Witnessed the Northern Lights, explored Helsinki's design scene, and enjoyed sauna culture. A winter wonderland!

visited.title: Norway 🇳🇴 – Fjords and Fjells
visited.content: Explored Oslo's museums, hiked in the fjords, and enjoyed the midnight sun. A breathtaking experience!

visited.title: Denmark 🇩🇰 – Hygge and History
visited.content: Visited Copenhagen's castles, enjoyed Danish pastries, and explored Viking history. A cozy adventure!

visited.title: Sweden 🇸🇪 – Innovation and Nature
visited.content: Explored Stockholm's archipelago, enjoyed fika, and learned about Swedish design. A blend of modernity and tradition!

visited.title: Hungary 🇭🇺 – Thermal Baths and Tradition
visited.content: Visited Budapest's thermal baths, explored the Danube River, and enjoyed local cuisine. A relaxing getaway!

visited.title: Croatia 🇭🇷 – Adriatic Adventures
visited.content: Explored Dubrovnik's walls, sailed in Split, and relaxed on Hvar's beaches. A coastal paradise!

visited.title: Slovenia 🇸🇮 – Lakes and Landscapes
visited.content: Visited Lake Bled, explored Ljubljana's charm, and enjoyed Triglav National Park. A hidden gem!

visited.title: Bulgaria 🇧🇬 – Mountains and Monasteries
visited.content: Explored Sofia's history, Rila Monastery, and the Black Sea coast. A blend of culture and nature!

visited.title: Serbia 🇷🇸 – Culture and Cuisine
visited.content: Visited Belgrade's nightlife, Novi Sad's festivals, and enjoyed local dishes. A vibrant experience!

visited.title: Georgia 🇬🇪 – Mountains and Melodies
visited.content: Explored Tbilisi's architecture, tasted local wines, and enjoyed the Caucasus Mountains. A cultural fusion!

visited.title: Azerbaijan 🇦🇿 – Modernity and Mountains
visited.content: Explored Baku's architecture, Gobustan's petroglyphs, and the Caspian Sea. A unique blend of cultures!

visited.title: Latvia 🇱🇻 – Baltic Beauty
visited.content: Explored Riga's architecture, Jurmala's beaches, and Gauja National Park. A hidden treasure!

visited.title: Lithuania 🇱🇹 – History and Harmony
visited.content: Visited Vilnius' Old Town, Trakai Castle, and the Curonian Spit. A blend of nature and culture!

visited.title: Estonia 🇪🇪 – Digital and Diverse
visited.content: Explored Tallinn's medieval charm, Saaremaa Island, and Lahemaa National Park. A digital wonderland!

visited.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina 🇧🇦 – History and Hospitality
visited.content: Visited Sarajevo's history, Mostar's bridge, and the natural beauty of the country. A warm welcome!

visited.title: Montenegro 🇲🇪 – Mountains and Mediterranean
visited.content: Explored Kotor's fjords, Budva's beaches, and Durmitor National Park. A stunning landscape!

visited.title: North Macedonia 🇲🇰 – Lakes and Legends
visited.content: Explored Skopje's history, Ohrid's lake, and the beauty of the countryside. A blend of cultures!

visited.title: Albania 🇦🇱 – Beaches and Breathtaking Views
visited.content: Visited Tirana's history, explored the Albanian Riviera, and enjoyed local cuisine. A coastal paradise!

visited.title: Liechtenstein 🇱🇮 – Alpine Adventure
visited.content: Visited Vaduz's castle, hiked in the Alps, and enjoyed local wines. A small but stunning country!

visited.title: San Marino 🇸🇲 – Ancient and Authentic
visited.content: Explored San Marino's towers, enjoyed local cuisine, and took in the views. A historical gem!

visited.title: Vatican City 🇻🇦 – Spiritual and Stunning
visited.content: Explored St. Peter's Basilica, the Sistine Chapel, and Vatican Museums. A spiritual journey!

visited.title: Luxembourg 🇱🇺 – Tiny but Terrific
visited.content: Explored Luxembourg City's history, enjoyed local cuisine, and visited the Ardennes. A hidden gem!

visited.title: Slovakia 🇸🇰 – Castles and Culture
visited.content: Visited Bratislava's Old Town, explored High Tatras, and enjoyed local cuisine. A blend of history and nature!

visited.title: Armenia 🇦🇲 – Ancient and Artistic
visited.content: Visited land's beauty, Mountain Ararat and an old Nuclear Power Plant! A blend of ancient and modern.

visited.title: United States 🇺🇸 – Diversity and Dreams
visited.content: From New York's skyline to Florida's beaches, I explored national parks and cities. A land of opportunities!

want_to_go.title: Iceland 🇮🇸 – Land of Fire and Ice
want_to_go.content: Want to witness geysers, waterfalls, and the Blue Lagoon. A natural wonderland!

want_to_go.title: Ukraine 🇺🇦 – Resilience and Richness
want_to_go.content: Hope to explore Kyiv's history, Lviv's culture, and the Carpathian Mountains. A testament to strength!

want_to_go.title: Belarus 🇧🇾 – Nature and Nostalgia
want_to_go.content: Would like to visit Minsk's parks, Brest Hero-Fortress, and the Belovezhskaya Pushcha. A journey through time!

want_to_go.title: Moldova 🇲🇩 – Wine and Wonders
want_to_go.content: Plan to visit Chisinau's wineries, explore Orheiul Vechi, and enjoy local cuisine. A hidden treasure!

want_to_go.title: Romania 🇷🇴 – Castles and Countryside

want_to_go.title: Ireland 🇮🇪 – Green Hills and History
want_to_go.content: Dream of visiting Dublin's literary pubs, exploring the Cliffs of Moher, and enjoying Galway's music scene. A land of legends!

want_to_go.title: Scotland 🇬🇧 – Highlands and Heritage
want_to_go.content: Want to explore Edinburgh's castles, hike in the Highlands, and savor whisky. A rugged beauty!

want_to_go.content: Would love to visit Monte Carlo's casinos, enjoy the Grand Prix, and relax on the beaches. A glamorous getaway!

want_to_go.content: Plan to explore Valletta's history, Mdina's charm, and the Blue Lagoon. A blend of cultures!

want_to_go.title: Andorra 🇦🇩 – Pyrenees and Peace
want_to_go.content: Would like to explore Andorra la Vella's charm, hike in the Pyrenees, and enjoy local cuisine. A hidden gem!

want_to_go.title: Kosovo 🇽🇰 – Emerging and Enigmatic
want_to_go.content: Hope to visit Pristina's history, explore the Rugova Canyon, and enjoy local cuisine. A hidden gem!
